nonfinite_reproducer.interpretation: All four replays log a nonfinite final evaluation. The returned zero is the discarded-sample replacement, not a valid integrand value. Both graph probes use the existing one-graph Monte Carlo selector and summed LMB channels. The underlying cause has not been isolated.

limitations: The quoted native errors are Monte Carlo estimates; large weights and discarded nonfinite samples prevent a precision validation.
Changing only e_cm to sqrt(K^2)=0.1 worsened the 100,000-sample error. Sampling has not been optimized.
This is a strict fixed-order scan. NLO dominates LO for the two smaller masses, so these are not controlled physical rate predictions.
No fatal root-isolation error occurred in these completed runs. This does not rule out such errors at other samples or smaller K^2.
